name: Calendly
description_en:
Calendly provides availability-based meeting booking: a host connects calendars, defines an event and shares a link so an invitee can choose a time. The current platform also advertises Contacts, Payments, Notetaker and the beta Callie assistant. They are distinct capabilities with different entitlements, not prerequisites for sharing a conventional booking link.

This profile centers on scheduling and its operational conditions. It separates calendar conflict checks from booking destinations, seat charges from invitees, and core scheduling from optional AI features. No scheduling, payment or meeting recording was executed for this research.
description_zh:
Calendly 提供依据可用时间预约会议的功能：主持人连接日历、定义事件并分享链接，受邀者选择时间。当前平台还介绍 Contacts、Payments、Notetaker 及 beta 阶段的 Callie 助手。它们具有各自权益，不是分享常规预约链接的前提。

本文重点说明排程及其运营条件，区分冲突检查日历与预约写入目标、付费席位与受邀者，以及核心排程与可选 AI 功能。本次研究未实际预约、付款或录制会议。

core_features.explanation_en: Select calendars to check for conflicts and a destination for new bookings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 选择检查冲突的日历，以及新预约的写入目标。

core_features.explanation_en: Protect time before/after meetings and cap bookings using event settings.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过事件设置保留会前会后时间，并限制预约次数。

core_features.explanation_en: Teams adds round-robin distribution and qualifying/routing forms.
core_features.explanation_zh: Teams 加入轮换分配与资格筛选/路由表单。

sections.title_en: One booking has two calendar decisions
sections.title_zh: 一次预约涉及两个日历决策
sections.en:
The setup guidance distinguishes calendars checked for busy time from the calendar that receives a new meeting. For a consultant using both work and personal calendars, the first controls conflicts and the second controls where the booking is written. Connect the account, grant access, choose both settings and confirm the connection before publishing a link.

Then book an illustrative consultation from another browser or participant account, including a different time zone. Compare the selected local time, the saved calendar event and conferencing details. This evaluation was not executed. A connected account alone does not prove the correct calendar was selected for checking or writing.
sections.zh:
入门说明区分用于检查忙碌时间的日历，与接收新会议的日历。对同时使用工作及个人日历的顾问，前者控制冲突，后者控制预约写到哪里。连接账户、授权、分别设置两者，并确认连接后再发布链接。

之后可从另一个浏览器或参与者账户预约一次咨询，并包含不同时区，核对选择的当地时间、保存的事件及会议详情。本文未执行这项评估。账户已连接，不能证明冲突检查与写入目标都选对。

sections.title_en: Availability is more than working hours
sections.title_zh: 可预约时间不只是工作时间
sections.en:
Calendly describes normal schedules, time-off handling, buffers and daily/weekly/monthly booking caps. It also allows some calendar events to be booked over using free/busy rules. Consequently, a slot’s visibility depends on several settings, not just whether the host’s calendar appears empty.

The official learning page describes Preview → Troubleshoot for inspecting an unexpectedly unavailable date and time. Use that reason before widening hours or deleting events. Check a buffer around an existing meeting and a last-minute request during evaluation, then verify the public booking page after saving.
sections.zh:
Calendly 介绍常规日程、休假处理、缓冲，以及每日/每周/每月预约上限；也可以通过空闲/忙碌规则允许覆盖某些日历事件。因此，时段是否显示受多个设置影响，不能只看日历表面是否空白。

官方学习页介绍通过 Preview → Troubleshoot 检查意外不可用的日期时间。调整工作时间或删除事件前，应先查看具体原因。建议评估现有会议前后缓冲及临时请求，保存后再核对公开预约页。

sections.title_en: Hosts need seats; invitees do not
sections.title_zh: 主持人需要席位，受邀者不需要
sections.en:
The Free plan lists one event type, one calendar connection and one-on-one scheduling. The yearly-billed pricing view shows Standard at $10 per seat per month and Teams at $16. The page explicitly says invitees need no seat; paid seats are for users who connect calendars and host meetings. These annual-rate figures are not monthly-cancellable checkout totals.

Standard adds multiple event types, reminders and Stripe/PayPal connections; Teams adds round robin, qualification and routing. Enterprise starts at $15,000 a year with a 50-seat starting point in USD. Optional Notetaker and Callie access appears under Plus/add-on choices and enterprise inquiry, not as an entitlement of the base Standard price. Payment-provider fees and AI add-on totals need separate confirmation.
sections.zh:
Free 列出一种事件、一个日历连接和一对一排程。年付定价视图显示 Standard 每席位每月 $10，Teams $16。页面明确表示受邀者无需席位，席位用于连接日历及主持会议的用户。这些年付费率不是可按月取消的结算总额。

Standard 加入多事件类型、提醒及 Stripe/PayPal 连接；Teams 加入轮换、资格筛选及路由。Enterprise 为每年 $15,000 起、起始 50 席位，以 USD 提供。可选 Notetaker 和 Callie 通过 Plus/附加选项及企业询价提供，不属于基础 Standard 价格的当然权益。支付处理费及 AI 附加总额需另查。

sections.title_en: Booking links, AI assistance and meeting capture
sections.title_zh: 预约链接、AI 协助与会议记录
sections.en:
Callie is described as an email-coordination assistant, while Notetaker produces meeting recordings/transcripts and recaps on supported conferencing tools. The pricing page states both are currently English-only. That language condition concerns these capabilities and should not be generalized to every Calendly surface or to the Chinese translation of this article.

Before enabling recording or payment, separately establish participant consent, applicable account permissions and the payment terms. A calendar booking does not prove an AI recap is accurate or that a payment/refund succeeded. Those tasks need their own acceptance checks and are not required for a simple meeting link.
sections.zh:
Callie 被描述为邮件协调助手，Notetaker 则在支持的会议工具中提供录制/转写和摘要。定价页表示两者目前仅支持英语。这一语言条件针对这些能力，不能外推为 Calendly 所有界面的语言范围，也不能从本文中文译文推导软件支持中文。

启用录制或付款前，分别确认参与者同意、适用账户权限及付款条款。日历预约成功，不能证明 AI 摘要准确或付款/退款完成。这些任务有各自验收条件，简单会议链接无需同时使用它们。

sections.title_en: Select for the meeting format and maintain it
sections.title_zh: 按会议形式选型并维护
sections.en:
Independent professionals can evaluate one-on-one scheduling; teams must also check collective/group event semantics and host distribution. A service needing inventory, physical-room capacity or a multi-day ticket basket should establish those requirements separately rather than infer them from the word scheduling.

When a slot or follow-up is wrong, inspect calendar access, selected conflicts, event rules and the actual saved meeting before resending invitations. The sources describe a managed platform; no self-hosted distribution, open-source licence, integration recovery or account-export completeness was verified.
sections.zh:
独立专业人士可评估一对一排程，团队还应检查共同主持/群组事件的含义及主持人分配。需要库存、实体房间容量或多日票务购物篮的服务，应另行确认要求，不能从“排程”一词推导。

时段或跟进异常时，重发邀请前先检查日历访问、冲突选择、事件规则及实际保存的会议。来源介绍托管平台，本文未核实自托管发行版、开源许可、集成恢复或账户导出完整性。
